data.long_meaning: The word Sampriti comes from the Sanskrit word ‘सम्प्रेति’ (Sampriti), which translates to ‘agreement’, ‘concord’, ‘friendship’, and ‘union’. This name signifies a peaceful, loving, and harmonious bond between two people. The name Sampriti carries the meaning “Friendship, Agreement” and is chosen by families in Hindu traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Hindu tradition and is also used in Sanskrit, Hindi. Parents who choose Sampriti usually hope their child will grow to embody friendship, agreement and live with faith, good character and purpose.

data.numerology_meaning: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of Sampriti total 6, giving a life-path number of 6. Number 6 is linked with Venus and with the qualities of responsibility, care and community.
